import re
import sys

env = {}

pattern = re.compile(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*|\d+)")

for match in pattern.finditer(sys.stdin.read()):
    name, rhs = match.groups()
    env[name] = int(rhs) if rhs.isdigit() else env[rhs]

order = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h",
         "i", "j", "k", "l", "m", "n", "o", "p", "TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {env[name]}" for name in order) + ";")
